text: Nice that worked. Ok the next thing, is on the world editor, i click to place something, lets say its just a floor, and so you see the floor placed, and there is a green outline [Image #18] but the moment i zoom in or out [Image #19] now this outline doesnt correspond with the grid space at all until the next stateful update of placing something

events.text: Root cause: the ghost outline is projected through the JS IsoStage at render time; wheel zoom mutates the stage + pushes the host camera imperatively with no React render, so the overlay kept the stale projection while the loader repainted (rotate/pan were fine — onMove's setSnap re-renders). Fix: onScroll re-snaps at the cursor after pushCamera, reprojecting the ghost with the fresh solve. One-line TSX change, hot-reloads. Commit in tree.
